name: io.github.louissarvin/proctor
description: Human oversight for AI agents. Blocks a tool call on a verified human who is not the operator, fails closed on a deadline, and returns a tamper-evident citation on a public ledger. The human-in-the-loop the MCP spec asks for and does not define.

environmentVariables.name: PROCTOR_API
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Proctor gate. Defaults to http://localhost:3700.

environmentVariables.name: HEDERA_AGENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Hedera account id of the paying agent, e.g. 0.0.12345. Set this with HEDERA_AGENT_KEY to settle a real x402 payment. Omit both and the tool falls back to Proctor's operator endpoint, which opens a real decision but settles nothing.

environmentVariables.name: HEDERA_AGENT_KEY
environmentVariables.description: ECDSA private key for HEDERA_AGENT_ID. Spends money: scope it to a funded testnet account and nothing else.

environmentVariables.name: AGENT_ALLOWED_TOKENS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated HTS token ids this agent may pay in. The agent's own guard: it refuses assets its operator never approved.
